nodes.description: Internal reflection balance mapping; credited/debited during transfers and team fee taking.
Declared token balance mapping (RFI, unused in transfer logic).
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read in transferFrom.
Fee-exemption flag per address, decides whether tax/team fee is taken.
Total reflections supply; reduced by _reflectFee on each feeable transfer.
Accumulated taxed token amount; increased by _reflectFee.
Reflection tax percent, zeroed/restored around fee-exempt transfers.
Team fee percent, zeroed/restored around fee-exempt transfers.
Bot blacklist mapping checked in _transfer and mutated by setBots/delBot.
Per-address cooldown timestamp written with block.timestamp.
Payable team address receiving swapped ETH and gating manualswap/manualsend.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, liquidity and approvals.
Created pair address used in transfer gating and cooldown logic.
Trading initialization flag set once in openTrading.
Enables contract-token auto swap inside _transfer.
Enables the uniswap-only and cooldown gating logic.
Max single transfer amount; enforced in _transfer, set in openTrading and setMaxTxPercent.
Reentrancy-style lock flag set by lockTheSwap and checked before swapping.
Constant total token supply used for supply rate math.
Ownable contract owner used by onlyOwner and owner().
Core transfer path: validates addresses/amount/bots/maxTx, handles cooldown and triggers contract swaps.
Approves router and swaps contract tokens to ETH via Uniswap, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Sends accumulated ETH to the team address with a direct transfer.
Owner-only initialization: sets router/pair, adds liquidity, opens trading and enables swaps.
Team-only manual trigger of swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance.
Team-only manual trigger of sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
Owner-only bulk blacklist of bot addresses.
Owner-only removal of an address from the bot blacklist.
Applies reflection amounts to sender/recipient balances, takes team fee and reflects the fee.
Mints reflection credit for the contract as the team share.
Reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee and increases _tFeeTotal.
Derives t/r amount tuples from tax and team fee percentages.
Computes the reflection rate rSupply/tSupply.
Owner-only update of _maxTxAmount from a percent with multiplication/division.
ERC20 transfer entrypoint delegating to _transfer with msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens and reduces the caller allowance.
ERC20 approve entrypoint delegating to _approve.
Returns token balance by converting reflections.
Owner-only toggle of the cooldownEnabled state variable.
Wraps _transferStandard with temporary fee removal/restore.
Plain ETH receive hook allowing liquidity/swap proceeds to be received.
Owner-only ownership renunciation setting _owner to zero.
Returns the current owner address.
Internal allowance writer emitting Approval.
Caller-controlled address used for auth checks, transfer source and fee logic.
Miner-influenceable time used for cooldown writes and uniswap deadlines.
Direct ETH value transfer to _teamAddress executed by sendETHToFee.
External call to uniswap router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin=0.
External payable addLiquidityETH call forwarding contract ETH balance.
External factory createPair call returning the pair address.
External ERC20 approve with type(uint256).max from the contract to the router.
Timestamp-dependent cooldown write cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 60 seconds.
Multiplication/division arithmetic computing _maxTxAmount from a percent.
Arithmetic reduction of _rTotal and increase of _tFeeTotal in _reflectFee.

address to parameter of _transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address into _transfer from transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender when reducing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
Caller address is constrained to uniswapV2Router/uniswapV2Pair inside _transfer.
openTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender with _owner.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
setBots is restricted by onlyOwner.
delBot is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent is restricted by onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
Cooldown check require(cooldown[to] < block.timestamp) makes transfer timing depend on the timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline argument.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline argument.
Timestamp is arithmetically extended into the cooldown mapping.
from parameter drives address validations and balance debits.
to parameter drives address validations, bot checks and cooldown writes.
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
sender parameter indexes the reflection balance debit.
recipient parameter indexes the reflection balance credit.
tAmount parameter is expanded into r/t value tuples.
maxTxPercent parameter feeds the _maxTxAmount computation.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist.
notbot parameter is removed from the bots blacklist.
onoff parameter is written into cooldownEnabled.
amount parameter is the value transferred to the team address.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped on the router.
contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokensForEth.
contract ETH balance is routed into sendETHToFee.
currentRate is produced by _getRate and consumed by value math.
rAmount derived value is subtracted from the sender reflection balance.
tTransferAmount is used when emitting the Transfer event.
_transfer writes the timestamp-dependent cooldown for buyer addresses.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call into the uniswap router.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the team address via transfer.
openTrading makes an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading calls the factory createPair external function.
openTrading approves the pair for max allowance via external call.
_reflectFee performs arithmetic on _rTotal and _tFeeTotal.
setMaxTxPercent computes _maxTxAmount with mul/div arithmetic.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth while processing a user transfer.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee to push ETH to the team.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard with the fee flag resolved.
_transferStandard takes the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard derives r/t values from _getValues.
_getValues queries the current rate from _getRate.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the transfer limit check.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist for both from and to.
_transfer branches on cooldownEnabled.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Router.
inSwap lock flag blocks nested swap execution during a transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic contract-token swap.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether the transfer is fee-bearing.
_transfer uses owner() as the fee-conditional exception address.
_transfer writes the caller-timed cooldown entry.
openTrading assigns the uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading assigns the uniswapV2Pair state variable.
openTrading enables swaps.
openTrading disables the cooldown gate.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading raises _maxTxAmount.
setMaxTxPercent overwrites _maxTxAmount using arithmetic.
setBots marks the provided addresses as bots.
delBot clears the blacklist flag for an address.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient reflection balances.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance with the team share.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflection supply.
_reflectFee accumulates the taxed fee total.
_approve writes the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads the sender allowance before subtracting.
The ETH push targets the team address state variable.
The router swap is executed against the stored uniswapV2Router address.
addLiquidityETH is invoked on the stored router.
createPair result is stored into uniswapV2Pair.
The pair approve call targets uniswapV2Pair.
Timestamp-based value is written into the cooldown mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer validation and balance logic.
The to parameter only exists to feed the _transfer validation, bot and cooldown logic.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer limit check and fee math.
sender parameter is only used to index reflection balances inside _transferStandard.
recipient parameter is only used to credit reflections inside _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is only used to derive r/t values inside _transferStandard.
maxTxPercent is only consumed when recomputing _maxTxAmount.
bots_ array is only iterated to write the bots blacklist.
notbot is only used to clear one blacklist entry.
onoff is only written into the cooldownEnabled flag.
amount is only forwarded as the ETH value of the team transfer.
tokenAmount is only approved and swapped on the router.
The local contract token balance is only computed to be passed into the swap.
The local contract ETH balance is only used to decide and send the team ETH.
currentRate is a temporary produced by _getRate for downstream math.
rAmount is a temporary reflection value applied by _transferStandard.
tTransferAmount is a temporary value emitted by _transferStandard.
